title: Better Botany
description: Adds the ability to Bone Meal small flowers, fixes the Jungle Sapling drop rate, and more!
body:
# Better Botany
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack lets you duplicate small flowers and other plants with **Bone Meal** in a Crafting Table, fixes a bug where **Jungle Saplings** have the incorrect drop rate, allows **Dead Bushes** to be renewable via smelting, and has **Tall Grass** and **Large Ferns** drop themselves when sheared!

This is designed to work with my [Better Non-Renewables Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/uglZSVKi)!
## Affected Blocks/Items
- All Small Flowers (except Golden Dandelion, Torchflower, and Wither Rose)
- Spore Blossom
- Sugarcane
- Cactus
- Cactus Flower
- Vines
- Nether Wart
- Chorus Flower
- Small Dripleaf
- Jungle Sapling
- Dead Bush
- Tall Grass
- Large Fern
## Recipes Added
I plan to update this datapack in the future to make **Bone Meal** work on the included plants outside of crafting. **Dead Bushes** are not duplicated via Bone Meal, but instead by smelting existing bush-adjacent plants.
## Loot Tables Altered
> **Jungle Leaves** now drop their saplings at the same rate as every other leaf block (5% of the time instead of 2.5%)
## IMPORTANT
> This datapack makes **Spore Blossoms**, **Dead Bushes**, **Tall Grass** (item), and **Large Ferns** (item) renewable when they are not normally!

> **Tall Grass** and **Large Ferns** are renewable in block form by bone mealing **Short Grass** and **Ferns** respectively, but the items themselves are normally only able to be acquired via generated loot in chests.
## More
I haven't figured out a good way to make modular datapacks, so don't be afraid to go into the file and delete any .json files in the [loot_table] or [recipe] folders you don't want!

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
